entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?

Hi David. I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought. I've had it for a bit over a month, and I'd like to talk about a return. I'm pretty sure I'm outside the standard window, but I was hoping we could work something out, maybe a partial credit or a discount on a future purchase?
I can certainly look into the options for you. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just a preference, really. It works perfectly fine, but the fit isn't quite what I was hoping for after wearing it for a while. There's nothing technically wrong with it.
I understand. Thanks for clarifying that. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered about 40 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right. So, like I said, I know it's probably too late, but any help would be appreciated.

Actually, I have some good news for you. While some of our newer electronic items have a shorter return window, your VeloBand GPS Tracker falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're only on day 40, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? 90 days? I must have misread the policy online. Wow, that's fantastic! So I can just send it back for a full refund?

That's exactly right. No negotiation needed. I've just started the return process on my end. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we just confirmed. Just package the device in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed.
That is so much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, David, I really appreciate the help.
You're very welcome, Alex. I'm glad we could get that sorted out for you. Will there be anything else today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful rest of your day.
